qe: How many bones are there in the adult human body, and how many of these form the axial skeleton?
qh: वयस्क मानव शरीर में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं, और इनमें से कितनी अक्षीय कंकाल बनाती हैं?
oe: 206 bones in all, of which 80 form the axial skeleton
206 bones in all, of which 126 form the axial skeleton
300 bones in all, of which 80 form the axial skeleton
260 bones in all, of which 80 form the axial skeleton
oh: कुल 206 हड्डियाँ, जिनमें 80 अक्षीय कंकाल बनाती हैं
कुल 206 हड्डियाँ, जिनमें 126 अक्षीय कंकाल बनाती हैं
कुल 300 हड्डियाँ, जिनमें 80 अक्षीय कंकाल बनाती हैं
कुल 260 हड्डियाँ, जिनमें 80 अक्षीय कंकाल बनाती हैं
e: Vayask manav shareer me kul 206 haddiyan hoti hain; inhe do bhaagon me baanta jaata hai. Pehla - akshiya kankal (axial skeleton), jisme 80 haddiyan hoti hain; isme khopdi (skull), reedh ki haddi (vertebral column), pasaliyan (ribs) tatha sternum aate hain. Doosra - upangiya kankal (appendicular skeleton), isme 126 haddiyan hoti hain; isme haath-pair ki haddiyan tatha kandhe (pectoral girdle) tatha kamar (pelvic girdle) ki haddiyan shaamil hain. Isliye 206 aur 80 wali jodi sahi hai. Naye janm lene wale shishu me haddiyan lagbhag 300 hoti hain, kyunki kai haddiyan aapas me judi nahi hoti; bare hone par woh jurkar 206 rah jaati hain - isliye '300 wali jodi' shishu ke liye sahi hoti, vayask ke liye nahi, tatha 126 upangiya bhaag ki sankhya hai. '260' ka aakda kisi bhi known sthiti se mel nahi khaata. Exam point: vayask me 206 haddiyan = 80 akshiya plus 126 upangiya; naye janm shishu me karib 300 haddiyan.

qe: The longest bone in the human body is the femur; which bone is the smallest?
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे लंबी हड्डी फीमर (जांघ की हड्डी) है; सबसे छोटी हड्डी कौन-सी है?
e: Manav shareer ki sabse chhoti tatha halki haddi 'stapes' hai, jo kaan ke madhya kaan (middle ear) me hoti hai aur dhaani (stirrup) jaisi dikhti hai. Yah dhwani ki tarango ko andar bhejne me sahayak hoti hai, isliye iske chhote aakaar ka bhi bada mahatva hai. Femur (jaangh ki haddi) sabse lambi tatha majboot haddi hoti hai; uske saath hi sabse chhoti haddi poochhna ek achha prashn banta hai. Radius aur ulna baaju (forearm) ki haddiyan hain - woh chhoti nahi hain. Hyoid ek U-aakaar haddi hai jo jeebh (tongue) ko sahayata deti hai; uski khaas baat yah hai ki woh kisi doosri haddi se juri nahi hoti, lekin sabse chhoti nahi hai. Patella (ghutne ki chappadi) ek sesamoid haddi hai jo ghutne ko suraksha deti hai. Exam point: sabse lambi = femur, sabse chhoti = stapes (kan, madhya-kan me), hyoid = jeebh se judi aur kisi doosri haddi se na jurne wali haddi.

qe: Which of the following statements about the human rib cage is correct?
qh: मानव वक्ष-पंजर (rib cage) के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?
oe: There are 10 pairs of ribs, all attached to the sternum
There are 12 pairs of ribs; the last two pairs are called floating ribs and are not joined to the sternum
There are 14 pairs of ribs, of which 5 pairs are floating
There are 12 pairs of ribs, all of which are floating
oh: 10 जोड़ी पसलियाँ, सभी उरोस्थि से जुड़ी
12 जोड़ी पसलियाँ; अंतिम दो जोड़ी तैरती पसलियाँ कहलाती हैं और उरोस्थि से नहीं जुड़तीं
14 जोड़ी पसलियाँ, जिनमें 5 जोड़ी तैरती हैं
12 जोड़ी पसलियाँ, जिनमें सभी तैरती हैं
e: Manav shareer me 12 jodi pasaliyan (ribs) hoti hain, jo peeth ki reedh tatha urasth (sternum) se judkar chhati ka panjar banati hain. Inme pehli saat jodi pasaliyan seedha urasth se juri hoti hain (true ribs) aur aathvin se dasvin jodi ka sambandh urasth se adhiktar upasthi (cartilage) ke through hota hai. Gyarhvin tatha baharhvin jodi ko 'tairti pasaliyan' (floating ribs) kehte hain, kyunki woh aage se urasth se nahi jurti; unka sirf peechhe ki taraf reedh se sambandh hota hai. Isliye 12 jodi aur do jodi tairti pasaliyon wala kathan sahi hai. '10 jodi', '14 jodi' ya 'saari pasaliyan tairti hain' wale kathan galat hain. Vakh-panjar ka mukhya kaam hriday tatha phephdon ki suraksha karna, saans lene me madad karna tatha kandhe tatha haath ko sahara dena hai. Exam point: 12 jodi pasaliyan = 7 jodi asli (true), 3 jodi aadhi juri, 2 jodi tairti (floating) jo urasth se nahi jurti.

qe: In vertebrates, the vertebral column of an adult human typically has how many vertebrae after fusion?
qh: कशेरुकियों में वयस्क मानव की मेरुदंड (कशेरुका स्तंभ) में संलयन के बाद सामान्यतः कितनी कशेरुकाएँ होती हैं?
e: Reedh ki haddi (vertebral column) 33 kasharukaon (vertebrae) se banti hai, lekin bade hone par neeche ki kuch kasharukayein aapas me judkar (fusion) alag-alag haddiyan ban jaati hain - sakral (sacral) 5 kasharukayein milkar 1 sacrum tatha koksijiyal (coccygeal) 4 milkar 1 coccyx ban jaati hain. Isliye vayask manav me kul 33 - 5 - 4 + 1 + 1 = 26 kasharukayein reh jaati hain: 7 gardan (cervical), 12 vakh (thoracic), 5 kamar (lumbar), 1 sacrum tatha 1 coccyx. Isliye 'vayask me 33' wala kathan galat hai - 33 to balavastha me ginti hoti hai. '20' ya '40' ke aakde kisi bhi known sthiti se mel nahi khaate. Reedh ki haddi ka mukhya kaam gati ka sahara dena tatha reed ki haddi ke andar ki nali me rhadd (spinal cord) ko suraksha dena hai; isliye iski ginti yaad rakhna pariksha ke liye mahatvapurn hai. Exam point: kul 33 kasharukayein -> vayask me 26 (C7, T12, L5, 1 sacrum, 1 coccyx); sacrum ke 5 tatha coccyx ke 4 jud jate hain.

qe: Which type of muscle tissue is striated in appearance but involuntary in function?
qh: किस प्रकार का पेशी ऊतक दिखने में रेखांकित (striated) होता है परंतु कार्य में अनैच्छिक होता है?
e: Manav shareer me peshi (muscle) ke teen prakar hote hain. Pehla - kankal peshi (skeletal muscle), jo haddiyon se juri hoti hai, rekhaankit (striated) dikhti hai aur hamari ichchha se chalti hai; isliye ise aechchhik peshi kehte hain. Doosra - hrday peshi (cardiac muscle), jo rekhaankit dikhti hai lekin hamari ichchha se nahi chalti; ise hrday ki dharkan apne aap (involuntary) hoti hai, isliye yahi is prashn ka sahi uttar hai. Teesra - chikni peshi (smooth muscle), jo rekhaankit nahi hoti aur anaechchhik hoti hai; yah aamashay, aanton tatha rakt-nasoon (blood vessels) ki deewar me milti hai. Tendon ek sanyojak utak hai jo peshi ko haddi se jodta hai; woh peshi nahi hai, isliye chautha vikalp galat hai. Isliye 'rekhaankit tatha anaechchhik' wala gun sirf hrday peshi me milta hai; kankal peshi rekhaankit tatha aechchhik hoti hai aur chikni peshi anaechchhik tatha arekhaankit. Exam point: kankal peshi = rekhaankit plus aechchhik; hrday peshi = rekhaankit plus anaechchhik; chikni peshi = arekhaankit plus anaechchhik.

qe: In the human body, the number of bones in the skull and the total number of bones in both hands (including wrists) respectively are:
qh: मानव शरीर में कपाल की हड्डियों की संख्या तथा दोनों हाथों (कलाई सहित) की कुल हड्डियों की संख्या क्रमशः कितनी है?
e: Khopdi (skull) me kul 29 haddiyan hoti hain - inme 8 kraniya (cranial) haddiyan hain jo dimaag ko dhakti hain, tatha 14 chehre (facial) ki haddiyan hain; is tarah 22 haddiyan 'khopdi' ke vyapak gher me aati hain. Sath hi 6 chhoti haddiyan kaan me (kan ki haddiyan) hoti hain, jinhe alag gina jaata hai; isliye kai pustakon me khopdi ki kul haDDiyan 29 likhi hoti hain. Ab haath ki ginti dekhein: ek haath me 27 haddiyan hoti hain - kalai (8 carpal), hathelI (5 metacarpal) tatha ungliyan (14 phalanges). Is hisaab se dono haathon me 27 x 2 = 54 haddiyan hoti hain. Isliye '22 tatha 54' wala vikalp un pustakon ke anusaar sahi hai jahan khopdi ko 22 maana jaata hai. Kuchh aadhaar khopdi ki 29 haddiyan batate hain aur dono haathon ki 54 - isliye woh jodi bhi milti hai. Is prashn ka sahi uttar wahi hai jismein dono haathon ki ginti 54 ho; '60' tatha anya aakde galat hain. Exam point: haath ki haddiyan 27 pratyek (8 kalai, 5 hathelI, 14 ungli) - dono haath 54; khopdi 29 (8 kraniya, 14 chehra, 6 kaan) ya 22 (bina kaan ki haddiyon ke).
